title: D&A: Decoupling Description and Assessment Enables VLMs as Zero-Shot Robotic Reward Models

title: Global refinery inputs fell sharply in the second quarter of 2026 before modest recovery
snippet: Crude oil refinery inputs in China fell by 2.1 million b/d in 2Q26 and by an additional 0.8 million b/d in 3Q26, while crude oil inputs in India, South Korea, and Japan fell by more than 1.0 million b/d collectively in 2Q26 before rebounding by 0.8 million b/d in 3Q26.
